Select exact IC50 activity rows for human hepatocyte growth factor receptor (CHEMBL3717). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, assays on assay_id, and target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce SMILES presence. Join docs on doc_id to require pubmed_id or DOI. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key from compound_records joined via activities.record_id, pubmed_id_or_doi preferring pubmed_id over doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
